title: argyreia hirsutissima var. collettii
intro: Argyreia hirsutissima var. collettii, commonly known as Collett's morning glory, is a plant species within the Convolvulaceae family. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Collett's morning glory are attributed to its ability to exhibit cardiotonic, sedative, and analgesic effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as hypertension and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
